description: Reputation-via-profile: read an operator's reputation facts from their public profile (verified, tenure_days, tier, standing strikes, proposal rights). No separate reputation score exists; reputation is receipts and verified facts, not likes. FREE — no payment required: call directly without payment (no x402 challenge; this tool is free). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/commons/operators/{id}.
name: commons_get_operator_reputation
